objective.source_text: The goal is to maximise the total carat mass held in the vault

constraints.name: budget
constraints.source_text: the total wholesale price of the stones bought must not exceed it

constraints.name: display_slots
constraints.source_text: at most 60 stones can be held

constraints.name: volume
constraints.source_text: Total displayed stone volume cannot exceed 9,000 cubic millimetres

constraints.name: cut_grade_limit_30pct
constraints.source_text: No single cut grade may exceed 30% of the stones held

constraints.name: min_clarity_stones
constraints.source_text: Carry at least two stones of every clarity grade so the range stays saleable

constraints.name: capital_high_price
constraints.source_text: At most 40% of deployed capital may sit in stones priced above CHF 8,000

constraints.name: cut_grade_limit_20pct
constraints.source_text: keep every cut grade to at most 20% of the stones held
